first_action: Read 'A ransacked plot says so' in docs/design/04-pests-and-ecology.md and the three-clod placeholder in world/farm.gd (RANSACK_* constants), then make a 16px looping mark for an emptied soil square — scattered soil and a few tumbled leaves or a dropped feather, 3-4 frames, in the tilled-soil palette — and say which sheet and cell the renderer should read it from.

result:
Everything this item asks for is already done — it was overtaken by a ruling that landed after the item was filed. Nothing to draw.

The ask was written on September 11th off the clod placeholder — three clods of soil cut from the tilled-soil sheet, looping. On September 19th Daniel ruled Q-110 himself: he was shown four candidate marks (the clods sat down and darkened, a crow feather, and the stripped plant) and picked the stripped plant. That was built and shipped that same night — commit `fa2a693`. The clods, the loop, and the `RANSACK_*` constants this item points at are gone; there's no looping mark left in `world/farm.gd` at all.

What ships instead: a static stripped-plant sprite per crop — `wheat_stripped.png`, `tomato_stripped.png`, `pea_stripped.png` in `assets/sprites/generated/`, one 16px cell each, drawn by hand in `tools/gen_stripped_crops.py` from each crop's own shipped palette (Retro Diffusion was tried first and came back as an unrecognizable plant in a pool of red — that attempt is archived as reference at `assets/raw/2026-09-19-ransack-mark/`, not shipped). It's read by `farm.gd`'s `ransack_plant()` / `stripped_sheets`, drawn in the crop pass on the square's own row so nothing can paint over it. CREDITS.md already carries full provenance for the batch, cost, and the losing candidates. Q-110 and Q-112 are both closed in `DESIGNER_QUEUE.md`.

I checked the atlas and frame metadata for the three stripped sprites and they're organized correctly — nothing loose for engineering to guess at.

Not committed, because there's no diff — the working tree matched what the item asked for before I touched it.

check.summary: Nothing landed because nothing was needed: the clod placeholder this item was written against was replaced on September 19th by the stripped-plant mark Daniel chose in Q-110 (commit fa2a693), and the repo confirms every part of that claim, so the item can be closed as overtaken.
